rationale: Lydia brings deep expertise in developer experience and technical education for complex tools—skills directly relevant to making Gooey.AI's low-code AI orchestration platform more accessible to developers. Dev is actively hiring software engineers and building abstractions that democratize GenAI workflows, while Lydia has a proven track record of bridging high-level product tooling with visual, in-depth technical content (Frontend Masters courses, 65k+ star repos). Both share conviction around making powerful developer tools approachable, and Lydia's experience shipping DX at Vercel and Bun could inform how Gooey.AI communicates its platform to teams adopting AI workflows.
